context.content: Good morning, For a long while I've been thinking about emigrating and having in consideration the current economic, political and social status of my country (Portugal) mixed with my professional situation I believe is time for me to start getting ready to go. I have a masters degree in software engineering in one of the best Portuguese colleges and I work as a backend software engineer (in a big company around here). I have a few certificates, and I work mostly with AWS (and their CDK), Java, Docker, K8s, Spring, Streaming technologies and I have two websites in React. I'm also learning German and I will finish the level A1.2 soon and start A2.1 in May. I'm aiming at changing around mid 2022 when I have B1 in German and some more experience as a backend developer. I practice *leetcode* and other things such as architecture and system design. **However, please note a FAANG is not my objective.** It's just to have a more than enough work rate for other places too. I'm looking for a country where I can work in a good competitive market but mostly, a good W/L balance and a paycheck that would allow me to live comfortably (in my country is very complicated). Just to put you in perspective, even in a top notch company here and with a top paycheck, I have to save for 3/4 months to be able to buy the last Iphone. If I want, for instance, to go to Japan I'm looking at spending a whole year savings. This being said, it doesn't have to be exactly Switzerland or Germany, I was just asking because of my German. In Switzerland I'm talking about Zurich of course and in Germany Berlin. However, what you guys suggest? How hard is to get into these markets? Or which other country/city you guys recommend? ​ Thanks in advance and happy coding :)
